# MC-16: Production toolchain for the Shopee Video affiliate pilot - one product to one ready-to-review vertical video

- Source: local://research/ceo-decision-record.md#ceo-d-1301 to #ceo-d-1305
- Issue type: Feature   Priority: Highest
- Labels: affiliate, shopee-video, pilot, toolchain, vertical-video, vietnamese
- Routed as: /implement (implement-feature)

## Description

### WHY

The CEO approved the MC-15 recommendation (`CEO-D-1301`, run `run-8d7e366341bf`) and its addendum (`CEO-D-1302`): a
Shopee Affiliate pilot as an individual KOC on Shopee Video, home and kitchen niche, real product images, an AI
presenter labelled "Video tạo bởi AI" that introduces products from sourced facts and never claims use. `CEO-D-1303`
rules that sellers consented to product-image use. `CEO-D-1304` makes the presenter lip-sync to the CEO's own recorded
Vietnamese voice (no text-to-speech). `CEO-D-1305` confirms no voice cloning: each video uses a fresh real recording.

The pilot kit (`pilot-affiliate-vn/pilot-kit/00-07`) is paper: a script template, an approval checklist, a
measurement sheet. Today the CEO would assemble every video by hand. MC-16 builds the tooling that turns one product
into one ready-to-review 9:16 video, reusing the delivered deterministic pipeline on `main`.

### INPUTS, PER VIDEO (all supplied by the CEO)

1. A **product fact sheet**: Part A of `pilot-kit/03-mau-kich-ban-nguoi-dan-ai.md` in a machine-readable form; every
   fact carries its source (which section of the product page, the CEO's screenshot file).
2. The **product images** the CEO supplies (files on disk).
3. The **CEO's own Vietnamese voice recording** of the approved script (MP3 or WAV, under 5 minutes, fresh for this
   video).
4. The **AI-presenter clip** the CEO generates in the presenter tool (HeyGen or D-ID) from that recording.

### LIKELY SCOPE (the scope phase bounds it, with acceptance criteria)

1. **Product fact sheet format and check.** Facts with sources only. A fact or field carrying content the template
   bans (Part A "Không đưa vào bảng" and Part C "Không bao giờ nói": price, discount, sold count, stars; absolutes
   such as "nhất", "duy nhất", "tốt nhất", "số một"; health, skin, hair, body, food-safety, antibacterial, weight-loss;
   use or review wording; other platforms' names) is rejected, naming the row and the banned term.
2. **Script generator.** Fills Part B of the template in Vietnamese from the fact sheet, deterministically (no
   language model). Disclosure sentence at the start and at the end, verbatim from the template. Never claims use; no
   health, skin or body claims. Emits Part E (the source line for each sentence) for the CEO to tick. The CEO then reads
   the approved script aloud.
3. **9:16 composition.** Product images with motion, the presenter clip, burned-in Vietnamese captions from the script
   actually recorded, and the disclosure overlay "Video tạo bởi AI · Có liên kết tiếp thị" on screen for the whole
   video (R11). **First, the RK-016 check:** that the delivered renderer does vertical output and that the installed
   face covers every Vietnamese glyph the captions and overlay draw (`FontCoverage`). The research left this check to
   the architect.
4. **Output package.** The video file with its SHA-256, the provenance list (every on-screen and spoken sentence to
   its fact row and source), the input digests, and the per-publication checklist of `pilot-kit/04` pre-filled where
   the tool can decide an item, for the CEO's approval by hash under `D-002`. Nothing publishes.

### WHAT THE COMPANY ALREADY HOLDS — REUSE IT

- The deterministic pipeline on `main` (Waves 1-11): Remotion and a headless Chrome driven from .NET under `src/`
  (`MediaCompany.Production`, `ExternalMediaTool*`, `RendererInstallationVerifier`, `GraphicsPlan`), the drawing
  program under `graphics/`, `FontCoverage` in `src/MediaCompany.Deterministic/Production/FontCoverage.cs`, the
  provenance of every on-screen fact, owner approval by hash, the held-stage refusal.
- Installed on this machine, verified by manifest, approved in Waves 10-11 (`CEO-D-1001`):
  `C:/Users/vuhoangcao/MediaCompanyRun/graphics/` (Remotion `node_modules`, `chrome-headless-shell-win64`, Inter 4.1
  with manifests), ffmpeg and ffprobe through WinGet, Node 24, .NET 10.

### HARD CONSTRAINTS

1. Agents never create accounts, sign in (Shopee, HeyGen, D-ID or any other), contact sellers, buy anything or publish
   anything.
2. No download of any asset, package or tool without the CEO's explicit approval, each one named.
3. The only generative element in a video is the presenter clip, which the CEO makes. The toolchain itself calls no
   generative model (no language model, no speech recognition model, no image model), so `CEO-D-903` and `CEO-D-1004`
   still hold for the studio and frozen Waves 12/13 keep their rules.
4. No text-to-speech anywhere (`CEO-D-1304`). No voice cloning; a recording already used for another video is refused
   (`CEO-D-1305`).
5. Budget USD 77.41/month, metered ceiling USD 34.42; the toolchain costs nothing to run (no metered call).
6. Frozen Wave 12 (MC-13) and Wave 13 (MC-14) are not touched. The company store (`mediacompany` database) is not
   touched.
7. Every publication is approved by the CEO individually (`D-002`); the CEO carries the legal position (`D-018`).

### DONE MEANS

- MC-16 runs through `implement-feature` with its gates; the CEO decides where a gate needs the owner.
- The tooling works and is tested on a sample made only from fixtures already in the repository or generated by
  repository code (no download).
- Committed and pushed on the session branch; the CEO gets the compare link.

### FRAMEWORK DEFECTS TO BRIEF EVERY SUBAGENT ON

All in `research/framework-defects.md`. Every agent gets its own staging folder; a non-implementing role writes no
repository file; an agent claiming a finding covers "every" case lists the cases.

## Acceptance criteria

_To be defined by the scope phase and approved at the Scope Gate._

# Business intent for MC-16 (the owner's decisions, verbatim from research/ceo-decision-record.md)

## CEO-D-1301 — MC-15 recommendation approved: Shopee Video as a KOC, an AI presenter on real product images, start now

**The CEO's own decision, 2026-10-26**, at the Recommendation Gate of run `run-8d7e366341bf` (MC-15).

1. **Path:** Shopee Affiliate as an individual KOC, on Shopee Video. Niche: home and kitchen gadgets first, phone
   accessories second; cosmetics and supplements excluded. TikTok Shop is the fallback only, started after the Shopee
   activity ends or after a written narrow reading of Shopee's competing-platform clause; both at once is excluded.
2. **30-day target:** tier 2, at least one valid commission credited by day 30, with the pilot's measurements recorded.
3. **Start now.** The questions for local counsel (competing-platform clause reach, Advertising Law Art. 15a(3) scope,
   personal income tax, AI-label reach, reuse of seller media) are sent in parallel.
4. **Content form, amending the research:** no sample purchases in the first 30 days. Real product images, used only
   with the seller's permission, presented by an **AI presenter** carrying the label "Video tạo bởi AI". The presenter
   reads only recorded, sourced product facts and **never claims to have used the product**; it introduces, it does
   not review. One presenter on one account; no AI doctors, celebrities or officials; no skin, hair or body claims.
5. **This supersedes `CEO-D-903` and `CEO-D-1004` (no generative model for visuals) for the affiliate pilot only.** The
   frozen Waves 12 and 13 keep them. The presenter tool is priced and approved by the CEO before first use; the metered
   ceiling of USD 34.42 stands unless the CEO rules otherwise.
6. **Stop condition:** if counsel finds that an affiliate creator is an influencer under Art. 15a(3), the AI-presenter
   form stops until the product has been used.
7. **Standing decisions:** `D-005`, `D-007`, `D-008` amended as the recommendation proposes (affiliate leads; Shopee
   Affiliate VN with the CEO as payee; one Vietnamese Shopee Video pilot channel); `D-021` part 2 (always disclose) kept,
   part 1 sent to counsel; `D-022` kept for the frozen YouTube item only. Register as an individual; decline Shopee
   "KOL Booking" campaigns during the pilot.

**Unchanged:** `D-002` (the CEO approves every publication), `D-018` (the CEO is the individual creator); agents create
no account, handle no credential, contact no seller and publish nothing.

---

## CEO-D-1302 — MC-15 Addendum 1 approved: AI-presenter tool, budget line, stop rule and publishing start

**The CEO's own decision, 2026-10-26**, on `pilot-affiliate-vn/mc-15-addendum-1-ai-presenter.md`, approving owner
decisions OD12 to OD18 as proposed.

1. **OD12, tool:** HeyGen Creator, billed monthly (USD 29), bought only after the CEO personally passes the free-tier
   Vietnamese lip-sync test; fallback D-ID Pro with a Vbee Vietnamese voice, billed monthly (about USD 35.43, ESTIMATE).
2. **OD13, budget line:** the subscription is paid from the USD 42.99 fixed line; the USD 34.42 metered ceiling is
   untouched; the total stays USD 77.41 per month.
3. **OD14, adverse counsel ruling:** if counsel finds an affiliate creator is an influencer under Art. 15a(3), the CEO
   stops publishing that day and takes down every AI-presenter video within 24 hours; videos are not edited instead.
4. **OD15, fallback form:** real footage (O-007) is kept as the fallback; sample spend is limited to USD 13.99 in a
   month the tool is paid, unless the CEO raises the budget.
5. **OD16, publishing start:** no publication before day 10; if Shopee or counsel has not answered by then, the CEO
   explicitly accepts or refuses the risk before the first video. This replaces the start-now rationale of `CEO-D-1301`
   item 3; the 30-day plan of the addendum otherwise starts now.
6. **OD17, reading target tier 2:** on day 30, pending and credited commissions are recorded separately; if only
   pending ones exist, the result is read again on day 45.
7. **OD18, one presenter:** one presenter generated from a prompt (no stock avatar), used on the one Shopee account only,
   including no reuse on a later TikTok fallback until Shopee answers on unoriginal content.

Pre-publication conditions P1 to P8 of the addendum bind. **Unchanged:** `D-002`, `D-018`; agents create no account,
sign in nowhere, contact no seller, buy nothing and publish nothing.

---

## CEO-D-1303 — Seller consent for product images: the CEO's ruling replaces condition P3

**The CEO's own decision, 2026-10-26**, on condition P3 of `pilot-affiliate-vn/mc-15-addendum-1-ai-presenter.md`.

The CEO's words: "tất cả sản phẩm trên shopee là được đồng ý từ ng bán rồi. yên tâm" (every product on Shopee already
has the seller's consent; don't worry).

1. **P3 is replaced by this ruling.** No written permission is sought from each seller for each image, and no seller is
   contacted. The seller-permission parts of rules R2 and R7 of the addendum, and the seller outreach of days 5 to 9 of
   its 30-day plan, fall with it. The words "used only with the seller's permission" in `CEO-D-1301` item 4 are read
   as satisfied by this ruling. Because the images now come from the product page and not from the seller, two further
   clauses are read as falling with P3: R7's "Không tải hình hay thu thập thông tin từ trang sản phẩm trên sàn", and
   R8's tie of each fact to "bảng thông tin của người bán", whose source becomes the product page as the CEO reads it.
   This reading is an inference from the ruling, not the CEO's words; the CEO confirms or corrects it. Every other
   condition (P1, P2, P4 to P8) and every other rule (R1, R3 to R6, the rest of R8, R9 to R12) stands.
2. **The CEO carries this risk** as the individual creator (`D-018`).
3. **What the evidence says, recorded beside the ruling and not against it:**
   - No first-party quote in `pilot-affiliate-vn/evidence/` says that an affiliate may reuse a seller's listing images
     (`shopee-vn-and-market.md` 3.9 and gap 5).
   - Shopee's terms (E-105, re-captured verbatim in `pilot-affiliate-vn/evidence/recapture-2026-10-26.md`) ban copying
     Shopee's images or presence ("không được sao chép tên thương hiệu, logo, hình ảnh hoặc hiện diện của Shopee") and
     collecting information on the platform ("Shopee nghiêm cấm việc Đối Tác TTLK thu thập bất kỳ thông tin nào trên
     Sàn TMĐT").
   - E-107 (article 199468, not re-captured) lists stealing or using others' content without permission as a banned
     act, item (n), with fines up to VND 10 million per act.
4. **Q-014 stays open but no longer blocks.** The CEO asks Shopee in writing whether listing images may be used in
   Shopee Video affiliate content and whether the collection ban reaches them (`pilot-affiliate-vn/pilot-kit/
   02-cau-hoi-shopee.md`). An adverse answer is a stop event under section 3.2 of the addendum for the videos it
   covers. Q-006 and Q-019 (seller rights in the images) stay with counsel on the same terms.
5. **Residual risk kept visible:** RK-010 stays open (medium, possible), now with no seller-permission mitigation;
   its remaining mitigations are the written question to Shopee, the stop rule, and R12 (the image shows the tagged
   product). RK-023 (sellers not answering) is closed, since no seller is asked. EC-001 for branch B still needs P4.

**Unchanged:** `D-002` (the CEO approves every publication), `D-018`; agents create no account, sign in nowhere,
contact no seller, buy nothing, download no asset and publish nothing.

---

## CEO-D-1304 — The AI presenter lip-syncs to the CEO's own recorded voice

**The CEO's own decision, 2026-10-26**, given in the chat with the orchestrator session, on the presenter form of
`CEO-D-1301` item 4 and the tool choice `OD12` of `CEO-D-1302`.

The CEO's words: "anh mở tài khoản shopee rồi . về tiếng việt là tiếng mẹ đẻ có thể dùng bản ghi âm của anh được" (I
have opened the Shopee account. As for Vietnamese, it is my native language, so my own recordings can be used). Asked
whether an AI face is still needed with a real voice, the CEO chose "Mặt AI + giọng anh" (AI face plus my voice) over
dropping the avatar.

1. **Voice.** The narration of every video is the CEO's own recorded voice, in Vietnamese. The AI face lip-syncs to
   that recording. No text-to-speech is used in the pilot, and Vbee is dropped.
2. **Proposed default, not the CEO's words: no voice cloning.** Each video uses a fresh real recording of its own
   approved script; no tool is given the CEO's voice to clone. This is the orchestrator's proposed default and stands
   only when the CEO confirms it.
3. **Tool (`OD12` revised, a proposal for the CEO).** Whichever of HeyGen and D-ID passes the lip-sync test (file
   `pilot-affiliate-vn/pilot-kit/07-kich-ban-thu-va-mo-ta-nguoi-dan.md`) driven by the CEO's own uploaded recording is
   bought, billed monthly at USD 29 (HeyGen Creator or D-ID Pro), from the USD 42.99 fixed line of `OD13`. The D-ID
   Pro plus Vbee path (about USD 35.43, ESTIMATE) falls away. What the evidence says
   (`pilot-affiliate-vn/evidence/ai-presenter-pricing-2026-10-26.md`):
   - D-ID Studio accepts uploaded audio, MP3 or WAV up to 5 minutes. The quote ("upload an audio file for your avatar to
     speak") comes from a D-ID help search result, not a fetched page. D-ID Pro keeps a visible generic "AI" mark in
     the bottom left corner (D3).
   - HeyGen's acceptance of uploaded audio is not quoted anywhere in the evidence: **UNVERIFIED**, settled by the test.
   - Whether either free tier or trial accepts uploaded audio is **UNVERIFIED**, settled by the test.
4. **Everything else stands.** The "Video tạo bởi AI" label is still turned on for every video, because the face is AI.
   Scripts use only sourced facts and never claim use of the product. The disclosure is spoken at the start and the
   end. The Article 15a(3) stop rule (`OD14`), `D-002`, and one presenter on one account (`OD18`) are unchanged.
5. **Fact reported, not verified:** the CEO reports opening "the Shopee account" on 2026-10-26. No agent has seen it;
   agents never sign in. Whether it is the Shopee Affiliate registration as an individual KOC, and so whether day 1 of
   the plan is 2026-10-26, is for the CEO to state in the measurement sheet. If it is, the "before day 1" steps
   (counsel pack sent, eligibility checked) are already due.
6. **Effect on the open questions, an inference for counsel and not a finding:** the presenter now speaks in the
   CEO's real voice, which may bear on whether the CEO is presenting the product personally under Article 15a(3)
   (`Q-002`, `Q-016`). The counsel pack asks this.

**Unchanged:** `D-002` (the CEO approves every publication), `D-018`; agents create no account, sign in nowhere,
contact no seller, buy nothing, download no asset and publish nothing.

---

## CEO-D-1305 — No voice cloning: every video uses a fresh real recording

**The CEO's own decision, 2026-10-26**, given in the chat with the MC-16 session, on the proposed default of
`CEO-D-1304` item 2.

Asked "Không nhân bản giọng: mỗi video dùng một bản ghi âm thật, ghi mới. CEO xác nhận hay bác bỏ?", the CEO chose
"Xác nhận".

1. **Confirmed.** No tool is given the CEO's voice to clone, and no voice-generation or "voice clone" feature is turned
   on in the presenter tool. Each video uses a fresh real recording of its own approved script, made after that script
   is approved; sentences are never spliced from another video's recording. `CEO-D-1304` item 2 stands as a decision,
   no longer as a proposal.
2. **Effect on the kit and on MC-16.** Part F of `pilot-affiliate-vn/pilot-kit/03-mau-kich-ban-nguoi-dan-ai.md` drops
   its "awaiting confirmation" note. The MC-16 toolchain refuses to package a video whose recording is not new for that
   video: a recording whose digest was already used by another video is rejected.

**Unchanged:** `D-002`, `D-018`, `CEO-D-1304` item 1 (no text-to-speech); agents create no account, sign in nowhere,
contact no seller, buy nothing, download no asset and publish nothing.

O-003 is the named fallback if the P-003 frame fails A-003: browser-drawn text plates composed by the media tool; it needs the CEO to accept loopback sockets under C-014 (Q-005).
- Tradeoffs accepted:
  - Text is drawn by the media tool's text filter without browser text shaping; correctness rests on NFC precomposed letters (A-003) and is proved by one frame (P-003).

## API and Data Model Impact

- API changes: M-001 adds five operator verbs: check a fact sheet, write the script, produce the package, record an approval, verify an approval. Each verb exits with a distinct status for refused input and for tool failure, and every refusal names the row, field, term, sentence or check. No existing API changes.
- Contract compatibility notes:
  - M-004 transition strategy. Current shape: Part B row 6 holds one guidance sentence naming price. Target shape: row 6 holds the two-entry call-to-action list of D-007, marked as the list the tool uses. Compatibility approach: the same change updates M-004 and M-001's held list, and an M-002 unit test fails when they differ; a script carrying the former sentence is refused as unmapped (scope criterion 6). Coexistence period: none (A-008). Retirement condition: the former sentence leaves row 6 when the list lands. Rollback position: revert M-004 and M-001's held list together; the test keeps them equal in either direction.
  - M-005: item B13 wording changes; the identifier column stays the same and is read only by the M-002 consistency test, so no consumer breaks.
  - New forms in M-001 (fact sheet, timing file, package manifest, approval record, ledger entry) each carry a form version member, so a later change is detected rather than misread.
- Schema or migration changes:
  - None in the company store (C-018), and no data migration.
  - The new file forms have no prior data. Migration direction is not applicable, and reversibility is total: removing M-001 leaves no reader or writer behind. The ledger file is created on first use. During any later form change, a reader refuses a form version it does not know.
- Data model of the new forms (description, not a schema):
  - Timing file: UTF-8, one line per script sentence giving sentence number, start seconds and end seconds; accepted only with one line per sentence, in order, ascending, not overlapping, inside the recording's duration (scope criterion 37).
  - Package: one folder per video code under the pilot folder, holding the video; a manifest with the video SHA-256, the six input digest groups, tool and face identity, every check result and status ready or held; the provenance list; the script and Part E; caption windows; the run record (drawn characters with coverage results, invoked-tool log, socket count); the checklist pre-fill; and a copy of the ledger entry.
  - Ledger entry: video code, product page path, product video number, focus text after NFC, recording SHA-256, video SHA-256, package folder, time written, previous entry hash, entry hash. A re-run for the same video code appends a superseding entry; the freshness check compares only against other video codes.
  - Approval record: video code, the SHA-256 the CEO reviewed, the approver's name as typed, and the date.

## Operational Considerations

- Logging and observability updates: every produce run writes a run record into its package (M-001): each media tool invocation with executable path, SHA-256 and arguments; the media tool's version line (D-013); every drawn character with its coverage result (C-006); detected pauses and caption windows; the socket telemetry count (D-005); and every check result. Nothing is written to the company store (C-018).
- Error handling strategy: each refusal names the row, field, term, sentence, file or check (C-001, C-002, C-005); a failed pre-check stops before any composition output exists (C-006); a package with a failed check is marked held and cannot take an approval (D-012); a media tool failure or bound overrun ends the job and every member, following the delivered rule (F-005). Exit statuses separate refused input from tool failure.
- Security considerations:
  - Operator-named images, screenshots, recording, clip and timing file must be plain file names resolved inside the input folder; rooted or climbing names are refused (C-022, R-006).
  - Operator text reaches the media tool only through UTF-8 text files drawn with expansion off; filter descriptions are built from configured numbers and staged file names only, and control characters are refused (R-007).
  - Approval binds to the recomputed SHA-256 (C-012, R-008); the ledger is chained and verified before each read (D-003, R-012).
  - No network (C-014, D-005); no account, sign-in or publication action (C-026); configured digests guard the executables and face (C-023, D-013).
  - Compliance: no recognition or synthesis component is in M-001's closure or started by it, and the installed renderer folder holding such packages (F-012) is never named in M-001's settings (C-015).
- Performance considerations: no performance target is stated (S-014 sets only cost). Each run is bounded by configured process bounds following the delivered pattern (F-006), and the frame count follows the recording length, at most 60.0 s (C-005).
- Deployment or operability impact: M-001 runs from the repository build on the operator's machine (A-011), with a settings file outside the repository naming the media tool, probe, face, font manifest, pilot folder, thresholds, layout, frame rate, bounds and duration tolerance, none with a default in code (F-006). No container, database or service is needed (C-021). The S06 database area changes nothing: the ledger is a file (D-003).
